committees.name: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal agency personnel and congressional committees, with indirect implications for elementary and secondary schools nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: coordinate Federal efforts to secure elementary and secondary schools... submit to the Committee on Homeland Security... a national school security strategy

dimensions.assessment: Requires administrative strategy development, reporting, and briefings without creating new operational security mandates or funding streams for schools.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary, in consultation... shall submit... a national school security strategy

dimensions.assessment: Requires administrative reporting and strategy formulation by federal agencies without specifying new funding authorizations.
dimensions.evidence: account for and describe all Federal programs, projects, activities, and authorities including associated spending levels

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to mandate a specific national strategy and congressional reporting process.
dimensions.evidence: Subtitle A of title XXII of the Homeland Security Act of 2002... is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Requires annual updates and briefings through 2033.
dimensions.evidence: annually through 2033 update the strategy, and brief the committees

missing_information: Resources required by DHS to compile the strategy and conduct annual briefings.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Homeland Security to develop, submit, and annually update a national strategy to secure elementary and secondary schools against acts of terrorism through 2033.
